author: Brenton Kemp
title: Robert Gasser optioned to minors
desc: The Brewers have optioned left-hander Robert Gassert to the ACL Brewers.
impact: Gasser allowed three earned runs in 5 2/3 innings against the Reds on Monday, but will head to the minors in what will likely be a brief stint. The Brewers actually play in Arizona against the D-backs this weekend, as it's likely Gasser will be recalled for a start back in the big leagues for the weekend series.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Ryan McMahon (infection) to be activated Friday
desc: Ryan McMahon will be activated from the injured list on Friday.
impact: McMahon is set to begin a rehab assignment on Wednesday before he is activated.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Giancarlo Stanton (calf) does not take live BP Tuesday
desc: Giancarlo Stanton did not take live batting practice on Tuesday.
impact: Yankees manager Aaron Boone misspoke when he said Stanton would take batting practice on Tuesday.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Max Fried (elbow) throws successful sim game Tuesday
desc: Ryan McMahon said Max Fried looked like his usual self during his live batting practice session on Tuesday.
impact: Fried faced both McMahon and Trent Grisham. There should be an update on his status in the coming days on next steps.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Cody Bellinger receiving day off Tuesday
desc: Cody Bellinger is getting the day off on Tuesday against the Tigers.
impact: Bellinger is just 2-for-24 at the plate over the past week. He gets the day off on Tuesday.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Kazuma Okamoto gets day off Tuesday
desc: Kazuma Okamoto is not in the Blue Jays lineup on Tuesday against the Mets.
impact: It appears to be a scheduled day off for Okamoto. Sean Keys gets the start in his place.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Alec Burleson sitting Tuesday
desc: Alec Burleson is not in the Cardinals lineup on Tuesday against the Braves.
impact: It appears to be a scheduled day off for Burleson. He hit .277 with six home runs in June.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Ryan Fernandez (back) activated from IL
desc: The Cardinals activated RHP Ryan Fernandez from the 15-day injured list.
impact: Fernandez returns from a multi-week absence with lower back pain. He should return to a high-leverage role in the Orioles bullpen.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Ryne Stanek placed on paternity list
desc: The Cardinals placed RHP Ryne Stanek on the paternity list.
impact: Stanek will be away from the team for a few days.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Lou Trivino has contract selected by Phillies
desc: The Phillies selected the contract of RHP Lou Trivino from Triple-A Lehigh Valley.
impact: Trivino signed a minor league contract with the Phillies in May. He'll hold a middle-relief role.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Chase Shugart optioned to Triple-A
desc: The Phillies optioned RHP Chase Shugart to Triple-A Lehigh Valley.
impact: Shugart will return to Triple-A with Lou Trivino returning to the majors.

author: Brenton Kemp
title: Chris Martin (shoulder) nearing return to active roster
desc: Rangers reliever Chris Martin (shoulder) is expected to pitch again on Wednesday and should only need a couple of outings before returning, according to manager Skip Schumaker.
impact: Martin began his rehab assignment with Double-A Frisco on Sunday, and will pitch again Wednesday before perhaps being activated. The veteran struggled to a 7.84 ERA in 12 appearances this season, but his 4.64 xFIP and 4.35 SIERA suggest notable positive regression should be headed his way.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Logan Henderson (back) to make next rehab start Friday
desc: Logan Henderson will make his next rehab start on Friday.
impact: Henderson will be making the second start on his rehab assignment. He struck out seven while throwing 50 pitches over three scoreless innings with Triple-A Nashville. He is expected to return before the All-Star break.

author: Brenton Kemp
title: Munetaka Murakami (hamstring) remains without rehab timetable
desc: White Sox first baseman Munetaka Murakami (hamstring) remains "day to day" with no timetable set for a rehab assignment, according to manager Will Venable.
impact: After a historic start to his MLB career, Murakami has been on the 10-day injured list since May 30. He is with the White Sox on their current road trip, but it doesn't sound like he is close to a return. The 26-year-old burst onto the scene with 20 home runs, 41 RBI, and a .938 OPS in 57 games before hitting the shelf.

author: Brenton Kemp
title: Simeon Woods Richardson clears waivers, assigned to Triple-A
desc: Blue Jays right-hander Simeon Woods Richardson has cleared waivers and been assigned to Triple-A Buffalo.
impact: The Blue Jays designated Woods Richardson on Friday, and it appears he will remain with the organization after going unclaimed on waivers. The 25-year-old has posted a 6.40 ERA in 15 outings (10 starts) between the Twins and Blue Jays this season.
